name: Fluid
tagline: Drag a finger through ink. The swirl stays on this device.
description:
Press and drag. Colour blooms behind the pointer, then folds into itself — a Navier–Stokes toy that already ran on phones. The quality, dye, bloom, and pause settings you pick come back the next time you open the file. Nothing is uploaded.

A random splat button and a screenshot live in the panel. On a phone the panel starts closed; tap the gear. There is no account and no store badge.

An unofficial port of WebGL Fluid Simulation by Pavel Dobryakov. Same ink, same pointer, no analytics.
